profiler_marker_source.native: Queue first appends a dependency barrier. Native timestamp_value inherits signal_value -> barrier() defaults, including HDC/untyped flushing and host-visible DC flush.
profiler_marker_source.l0: Same queue wrapper adds a barrier, then the L0 stream calls zeCommandListAppendWriteGlobalTimestamp. Actual driver timestamp packets are not captured here.
profiler_marker_source.conclusion: A concrete marker-specific path can perturb native timing differently. The causal cost of its flags is not isolated. Unprofiled release runs omit these markers, so this does not explain their throughput gap.
